name: Haixing

routes.outcome: Official Hebei public-resource announcement states that 海兴县自然资源和规划局 decided to transfer a county land parcel and that 海兴县公共资源交易中心 handles the transaction. This evidences a local land/natural-resources custodian, not a public cadastral vector service.

Official Haixing County government PDF contains the county bureau name 海兴县自然资源和规划局. It is administrative evidence only; no parcel geometry or viewer/API configuration was present in the retained result.
TLS-verified official county site returned a 57-byte redirect to /portal/index.html.
The redirected county portal path returned Not Found. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA, certificate bypass, or private token was attempted.

English and Chinese first-party searches and the reachable county landing response did not expose an official cadastral map viewer, JavaScript configuration, public parcel API, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry response.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel geometry response obtained; CRS and coordinate order remain unverified.

localCustodianAssessment: The official county-government PDF and official public-resource announcement evidence 海兴县自然资源和规划局 as a local natural-resources/land custodian and the county public-resource trading center as a related service operator. General national or provincial prose was not used as local registry evidence. No public local cadastral map/vector endpoint was verified.

qualification.reason: No anonymous parcel geometry or city-bounded public vector response was verified; serial review must independently qualify any real adapter before runtime consideration.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted to force a parcel hit.
No exact-point parcel hit or miss was used as a citywide absence claim.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon and native identity were obtained.
The county portal redirect ended in a 404, so current viewer JavaScript/configuration and any service route could not be inspected.
This packet records research completion only and is not source integration or registry admission.
uncertainty: Local custody is supported, but anonymous parcel-service reachability, viewer/API configuration, parcel schema/CRS, coverage, update cadence, licensing, and runtime behavior remain unverified. The absence of a public vector endpoint is an access/discovery limitation, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
